description: Runway ends. Headings supplied by the owner, 23-10-2026, replacing the earlier placeholders. Wind direction and heading share one reference (OD-11), so headings are entered in the reference the weather reports use. Each end has a threshold latitude and longitude (decimal degrees) so the runway picture can be drawn to scale.
source: headings: owner, 23-10-2026. Threshold coordinates: OurAirports open data (community data), retrieved 26-10-2026.
